autocomplete-buttons: The adornment buttons are children of the .form-control-group itself now, laid out by the group, so the wrapper is gone. Use .form-control-action / .form-control-cleaner on the buttons.
autocomplete-cleaner: The frame of every field component is the shared .form-control-group primitive now. Use .form-control-action for an adornment button, .form-control-cleaner for the one that clears the value, .form-control-icon for decoration, and .form-control-sm / .form-control-lg on the group for sizing. See the v6 migration guide.
autocomplete-dropdown: The generated options dropdown is the shared combobox surface now (.popup + .combobox-popup), so the component never emits this class - see "Autocomplete and Multi Select share one options menu" in the migration guide. The last selectors carrying it only fed tokens to a teleported dropdown that had stopped existing.

See the v6 migration guide.
autocomplete-input: The editable inside a field component is a plain .form-control now — the group strips its frame, so it needs no class of its own. See .form-control-group in the v6 migration guide.
autocomplete-lg: The frame is the size surface now: put .form-control-sm / .form-control-lg on the .form-control-group. The family-named class declared its tokens on the component root, where the frame's own declarations shadowed them - it never had an effect in v6.
